image: Flag of the Land of Valencia (official).svg
name: Valencian Community
summary: The Senyera of four red stripes on gold, with a blue band at the hoist topped by a crown. It is called the Real Senyera.
origin: The blue band with a crown was added to the Valencian Senyera in the late Middle Ages, reflecting the royal privileges of the city of Valencia. The flag was adopted in 1982.

symbols.name: Crowned blue band
symbols.description: A blue vertical band with a gold crown.
symbols.meaning: Royal privileges of the city of Valencia.

facts: Use of the blue band was a point of dispute between Valencian and Catalan identities.
clues: Red and gold stripes with a crowned blue band at the hoist.
Like Catalonia's flag with a royal blue band added.
